geometry.derivationNote: The 1973 protocol legally defines the boundary as the 290-degree line from the coastal land-boundary terminus to the common outer 12-nautical-mile limit. The later bilateral protocol-description fixes the demarcated endpoints at 41°31′18.39″ N, 41°32′55.06″ E and 41°35′43.41″ N, 41°16′40.88″ E.

territoryChanges.notes: Valid as a Soviet state-border fragment from treaty entry into force. It ends with the USSR polity and is not inherited by the Russian Federation because the adjacent Soviet coast became Georgian territory.
